title: ttr-skill/v1 — skill-file frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of `lexicon/skills/*.md` (RV-35/37; contracts §2). The frontmatter compiles into the lexicon as operator-word entries; the markdown BODY is a Golem-side behavior artifact and is not described by this schema.

schema.description: Ledger id. Must equal the id of the schema the frontmatter is validated against.

op.description: The operator this skill binds. `op:` ref class (ruled RV-1) — e.g. `op:trend`.

triggers.description: The operator words. A skill with no triggers can never fire, so at least one is required.

requires.description: Applicability constraints, validated at compose time — not at match time (contracts §2).
